title: STCore
description: STCore is an addon for the WATHE: Murder Mystery mod.
body:
STCore: For use on gamenights on SurvivalState

Adds in custom roles into the Murder Mystery server. 

The Cultist: Your fellow cult members have gone missing. As a cultist, you must use your powers to revive The Idol, your cult leader. This isn't without cost however. You must sacrifice one living member to bring back the idol. Once the Idol is alive, your cult will live on. 

The Idol: Awakened by the cult, your goal is to kill all the civilians on the ship in cohorts with the killers.  You have special abilities to take any of the remaining players out...
